quote: Six of us, two guides, three days on the ridge. I've never felt so looked after on a walk.
name: A. Demo

quote: Sam turned us around at Federation Hut when the weather came in, and I was grateful. Right call, good pub afterwards.
name: B. Demo

quote: The night walk was the highlight of our trip. Dinner at the hut, then the sky. The kids still talk about it.
name: C. Demo
